recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current wording should remain because it captures both halves of the accepted rule: mandatory error status and non-mandatory OperationOutcome except as SHOULD-level guidance for FHIR-aware failures.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking to clarify whether the SHALL in the search-failure sentence applied only to the 4xx/5xx status code or also mandated OperationOutcome, and to fix the duplicated 'return value return value' typo.
initial_application: Commit 639dbcd2848776be444488fe66b23438c581256d applied FHIR-27051 by replacing the FHIR-30240 interim 'possibly accompanied' text with the current FHIR-aware SHOULD sentence. Commit 015eea66b7a4dadf8706d7d751e2ac58256d01c1 later formatted 4xx/5xx as code tokens without changing meaning.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the rationale that 4xx/5xx responses can be generated before FHIR comes into relevance, so OperationOutcome is not a SHALL. FHIR-I minutes show the issue was assigned for wording, and Jira records the later Published/Persuasive resolution and vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/http.html wording matches the resolution and no old mandatory or interim optional search-failure sentence remains in current source.
